title: Backoffice bootstrap approval repository is under service IA and embeds SQL
actual: The currentized broad safety gate reaches BackofficeBootstrapApprovalRepository.java and fails its no-inline-SQL contract.
rootCause: The repository was authored under auth/service with six Java text-block SQL statements and one dynamically concatenated predicate, bypassing CpfVendorSqlCatalog, the canonical runtime-query contract, DB3 rendering, query parameter parity and Repository technical-role IA.
repair: BackofficeBootstrapApprovalRepository moved from auth/service to auth/repository; BackofficeBootstrapRunner imports the repository owner. Six inline/dynamic statements became six named portable canonical templates, the repository injects the official Backoffice CpfVendorSqlCatalog, and platform-runtime-query-contract.json registers exact consumer/parameter contracts. DB3 render, query gate and compile/test remain.
